Built on an infinite AI canvas, Design Studio 2.0 brings your references, drafts, iterations, assets, and ideas into one fluid workspace. You can remix visuals, explore endless ideas in one space, edit with brushes, refine layers and elements, and co-create with an AI design agent in real time.

Just think visually and create freely. Because maybe, you were always more creative than you thought!

Stop templating. Start designing now.

ただ視覚的に考え、自由に創造してください。もしかしたら、あなたは思っていた以上にクリエイティブだったのかもしれません！
